long_biography.plain_text:
Marketing studies led Miryan into events and luxury property. The Brazilian entrepreneur moved to Portugal in 2017, using frequent travel between South America and Europe as the starting material for a public-facing fashion and lifestyle platform.

Her executive career now centres on Bravantic, where she serves as chairwoman of a technology-services group operating across several Portuguese-speaking markets. Alongside that role, Miryan develops commercial content for luxury brands and has built a large Instagram audience. That combination has made enterprise technology, property, entrepreneurship and digital media the principal strands of her public work.

uncertainties.detail: SuperYacht Times withholds DY Miryan's owner identity. The vessel name exactly matches Dyanne 'Dy' Miryan's distinctive public name, its public dimensions match the authoritative record, and the exact legal person is principal of a Bravantic Lifestyle entity classified in water passenger transportation. This is a strong compound bridge but not a public beneficial-ownership declaration, keeping identity confidence at ninety-four.

Official Madeira filings use DYANNE MIRYAN EUGENIA DOS SANTOS TRINCHEIRAS DE FIGUEIREDO without accents, the owner record uses Eugénia, the Bravantic page uses Dyanne Myrian and public media commonly use Dyanne or Dy Miryan. Exact company, role and surname continuity show these variants refer to the same person; the dossier preserves the authoritative legal display name.

Bravantic's official page identifies António Trincheiras as founder and Dyanne Miryan as chairwoman. Madeira filings show her as manager but identify Bravantic Global Ltd, not Miryan personally, as the shareholder of Bravantic Lifestyle. The dossier therefore classifies her as Operator, not Founder, and makes no personal shareholding claim.

Public profiles document Miryan's own work in marketing, luxury property, events and commercial content, as well as her marriage to Bravantic founder António Trincheiras. They do not quantify income, disclose the group's ownership, or establish a transfer mechanism. Wealth creation and origin remain Unknown rather than being assigned to real estate, social media, inheritance or marriage.

Enterprise technology is the strongest current operating field through Miryan's Bravantic chairwoman role. Personal economic ownership is not public, and her property and media activities remain substantial, so Technology is classified with high rather than very-high confidence.

Three publication-date age reports intersect on a 1995 birth year, but no reliable source gives a full birth date. NiT identifies Pernambuco as her birthplace without a city. The dossier proposes only the supported year, state and country and leaves day and month blank.

Media profiles say Miryan moved to Portugal in 2017 and associate her public career with Lisbon, while Madeira corporate filings in 2022 and 2023 record a São Paulo address. Because neither establishes a definitive current principal residence and her work spans several regions, no main or secondary residence proposal is made.

The @dymiryan Instagram account is repeatedly and directly attributed by independent editorial profiles and is proposed. No collision-safe personal LinkedIn, personal website, Facebook, Twitter, YouTube or TikTok profile was verified to the same standard. Bravantic's canonical site is proposed as a company website.

The biographies retain Miryan's durable marketing, property, technology and digital-media development while excluding the yacht, audience counts, fashion itineraries, private-family details, unverified ownership and net worth.
